entities.summary: Heinrich Pesch, S.J. was a German Jesuit philosopher and economist of the Solidarist school. His major work, Lehrbuch der Nationalökonomie, is generally regarded as a source for Pope Pius XI's social encyclical Quadragesimo anno.
